cards.name: 坏心情走开！

cards.scene: Concept: removing harmful conditions, not damage or a shield. Extreme close tender scene: a tiny round hedgehog buddy occupies lower center, one large tangled dark olive smoky ribbon curls above its head. From upper left the approved girl's cream-sleeved hand swings a large golden handbell, its mouth aimed toward the smoky knot. ONE broad pale cream sound arc pushes the dark curl away toward upper right; the curl visibly breaks apart outside the sound front. Hedgehog's relieved cheek and a corner of heroine's strawhat at left are secondary. Bell and departing dark knot dominate. Cream background, muted sage, golden bell, strong dark-vs-light separation. No shield bubble, no stars orbiting a stunned head, no musical-note symbols. The first read must be bell clears an unwanted thing, rather than bell attacks an animal.

cards.name: 门缝借过！

cards.scene: Concept: a small magical shot finding a gap in armor, partial piercing of block, NOT multiple targets. Massive rounded wooden shield fills lower-right two thirds, tilted so a clear narrow triangular opening appears near upper center. ONE small concentrated warm cream-blue glowing seed-shaped bolt travels diagonally from lower left through this OPEN GAP and taps the huge green goblin's protruding nose behind shield at upper right. One short bright contact flash and surprised eyes at extreme upper-right edge. Only heroine's tiny cream-sleeved pointing hand and hat rim at lower left if necessary. Shield should be a big simple dark teal/brown shape; luminous bolt and narrow gap main contrast on quiet dusty blue background. No laser slicing through solid wood, no huge explosion, no two separate bolts, no wound.

cards.scene: Concept: net hinders a strong enemy, not an instant defeat or total immobilization.
